appearance_facts.fact: A dark red slice occupies the top-left quadrant, spanning from the 12 o'clock position to roughly the 10 o'clock position.
An orange-red slice occupies the left side, spanning from roughly the 10 o'clock position to the 7 o'clock position.
A pale yellow slice occupies the bottom, spanning from roughly the 7 o'clock position to the 4 o'clock position.
A light orange slice occupies the right side, spanning from the 4 o'clock position back to the 12 o'clock position.
The dark red slice visually covers the largest angular extent, appearing to span half of the circle.
The orange-red slice is the second largest, appearing to span a quarter of the circle.
The light orange slice is smaller than the orange-red slice, and the pale yellow slice is the smallest.

public_definitions: Review the global energy mix dashboard, identify the largest global energy consumption source category, then route that source record to priority source monitoring for this reporting cycle.
Use the dashboard to determine which energy source is the largest category in global energy consumption for this routing decision.
Routing criterion: Largest global energy consumption category
